brandStory.label: Our Story
brandStory.title: Born from the meeting of two completely different mindsasdasd
brandStory.mumbaiFounder: One founder grew up inspired by the relentless energy, diversity, and street culture of Mumbai. To them, beer was never just a drink — it was about bringing people together, celebrating stories, and creating unforgettable nights.asdasdasda asdasdasd
brandStory.nordicFounder: The other founder was deeply inspired by Nordic values: simplicity, precision, sustainability, craftsmanship, and thoughtful design. They believed that every product should be intentional, beautifully designed, and built to last.aaasdasda asdqwd
brandStory.conclusion: Together, they realized that India's craft beer market lacked a brand that combined premium brewing with meaningful storytelling and world-class design.
brandStory.bridgeText: FUDDLER was created to bridge these two worlds

beliefs.text: Every bottle should remind people of a conversation, a friendship, a celebration, or the beginning of a new story.
